announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.10.14 — plugin AutoCAD ARA Juru 1.5.1: perintah Isi kamar mandi (ISIKM) kini benar-benar jalan (di 4.10.13 belum dikenali AutoCAD). Klik di dalam kamar mandi: kloset, wastafel, dan shower atau bathtub ditata otomatis; Tukar memberi susunan yang benar-benar berbeda, dan ruang lega mendapat shower/bathtub terbesar yang muat. Update terpasang otomatis saat aplikasi dibuka.
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.10.14 — AutoCAD plugin ARA Juru 1.5.1: the Fill bathroom command (ISIKM) now actually works (AutoCAD did not recognise it in 4.10.13). Click inside a bathroom: toilet, basin and shower or bathtub are laid out automatically; Swap gives genuinely different layouts, and roomy bathrooms get the largest shower/bathtub that fits. The update installs automatically when the app opens.
